Phase 5 complete — all four edits landed, verified. Exact results:

## Changes (5 files, nothing else touched)

1. **`next.config.ts`** — added the `/encore/:path*` block after `/nocturne`: `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'` + `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, matching the sibling blocks exactly.
2. **`src/components/landing/live-demo-data.ts`** — appended the eighth entry: `id: "encore"`, `route: "/encore"`, `url: "unown-nine.vercel.app/encore?embed=1"`, `poster: "/landing/encore/poster.png"`, `resetType: "encore-reset"`, receipt `{sessions: 17, toolCalls: 513, files: 24, tests: 125, commits: 3, embeddingAdaptations: 0}`, `receiptDoc: …docs/encore-demo-session.md` — plus the encore narrative header block (e1–e10 envelopes · 513 tool calls · 3 commits · 125 green) matching the sibling voice.
3. **`src/components/landing/live-demo.tsx`** — gallery lede re-numbered: "Six apps, live." → **"Eight apps, live. Pick one."** (it was stale at six; seven had also passed it). The built-improved lede re-numbers itself via `ordinalOf(LIVE_DEMO_APPS.length)` — now renders "(Encore, the eighth app)", zero manual edits.
4. **`__tests__/live-demo.test.tsx`** — count pin `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(7)` → `…(8)`, test renamed "eight apps".
5. **`__tests__/built-improved.test.tsx`** — the plan's named drift hazard: hard pin `toBe(7)` → `toBe(8)`; last-app identity pins moved nocturne → Encore (`id "encore"`, name "Encore", "(Encore, the eighth app)").

## Verification (exact results)

- **`bun test src/components/landing`**: 135 pass, **1 fail** out of 136 (2269 expect calls) — green-pending-poster.
- **`bun run typecheck`**: exit 0, clean.
- **`bun run lint`**: exit 0 — 4 pre-existing warnings (scripts-dev/fugue, not this round's files), 0 errors.

## The one remaining artifact — the poster (operator action)

The single failing test is `live-demo band > every poster exists on disk with the real intrinsic dimensions` — the encore entry's `/landing/encore/poster.png` does not exist yet (the assertion left as-is per the brief; no fake media created). It asserts 2880×1800 IHDR. To close it: `bun run build` + `bun dev` (or the live server), then `bun scripts/landing_demo_poster.mjs` — the lane reads `LIVE_DEMO_APPS` and auto-shoots the eighth poster into `public/landing/encore/poster.png` without any script change. All other poster assertions pass.

## Rules honored

- Gallery data/copy only — no other landing bands touched; AGENTS.md, receipts, `src/lib/` untouched.
- Scroll budget: the eighth tab is a fixed-height scroller entry (content, not height); the lede compression "Eight apps, live. Pick one." is 4 words, so net page word delta is neutral. `e2e/landing-budget.spec.ts` unchanged (15.5vh / 3750w / 3vh ceilings intact).
- **Note for commit:** `docs/encore-demo-session.md` (the receiptDoc target) is currently **untracked** in this working tree (`?? docs/encore-demo-session.md`), alongside `docs/website-excellence-session.md` (modified, CP3 closed). They belong to this same change but I did not touch docs per your constraints — the operator should include them when staging the landing commit so the GitHub receiptDoc link resolves.
